title: ETHOS: AN ONLINE HATE SPEECH DETECTION DATASET

bias_targets.methodology: Crowdsourcing annotations of YouTube and Reddit comments via the Figure-Eight platform to detect gender-directed hate speech, and evaluating detection performance using multi-label classification models like BiLSTMs and BERT.
